text: Ok so before we finish up with your portion, the part that needs to land a bit cleaner is the selection of the thing and spinning the camera, currently, i click on something like a face, spin the camera and its deselected. also, i need to be able to select multiple faces or edges or vertex at a time, so we need there to be shift control to group them together
resolution: Selection persistence + multi-select grouping. Two fixes in Studio.tsx onDown: (1) a MISS (clicking empty space) no longer clears the selection — it just falls through to the orbit drag, so spinning the camera by dragging off in empty space keeps your selection. Deselect now comes only from picking a new element (plain click = replace) or Esc. (2) The add-modifier is now shift OR ctrl (or meta) so you can group multiple faces/edges/vertices: applyPick toggles each into the per-mode set. Clicking on an element still does NOT orbit (you can't spin by dragging on a face — the user confirmed that is correct). Bundle-clean, hot-reload, fps untouched.
